about: Recipe for the three disco loops in src/ui/music. Used by tools/media/make_music.py. The prompts describe a style only: no song, band or artist is named or imitated, and no recording is used as input.

model.name: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo (Diffusers format)
model.licenseNote: ACE-Step weights: MIT. The text encoder inside the same repository (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B) is Apache-2.0. The model card says the generated music may be used commercially.

vocalCheck.name: Demucs v4 (htdemucs), used only to measure how much singing is in a candidate

levels.name: groove
levels.prompt: 1970s disco instrumental, tight and steady dance-floor groove, four-on-the-floor kick drum, crisp open hi-hats on the off-beats, funky octave-jumping electric bass line, choppy wah-wah rhythm guitar, clavinet, handclaps on two and four, warm analog studio recording, live band feel, no vocals
